svg.title: Airport operations
svg.text: Four terminals, two runways, 120 stands. The operations database is the source of truth for every flight; everything else listens to it or feeds it.

g.title: L1 · Wayfinding still polls the old displays feed

g.text: Everything that knows a time of a flight
writes it here first; nothing reads another
Wayfinding still reads the old FIDS feed; it
